meta.title: Revelti - The event doesn't end when the music stops.
meta.description: Revelti is the all-in-one platform for event organizers, creatives, and attendees. Stop juggling tools. Join the waitlist and be the first to experience it.
meta.og_title: Revelti - The event doesn't end when the music stops.
meta.og_description: One platform. Organizers. Creatives. Attendees. Memories that live forever. Join the waitlist.

hero.sub: Revelti is one ridiculously simple platform where event organizers run the show, creatives get their spotlight, and attendees relive the night forever.
hero.org_card_desc: Ticketing, audience email, collaborator management, stats and event galleries in one beautiful place.
hero.cre_card_desc: No more WeTransfer links. Cloud storage, seamless delivery and automatic portfolio building with customized galleries.
hero.att_card_desc: Buy tickets, access event schedules, see who's going, and get direct photo updates instantly.

problem.label: The old way
problem.headline:
Events shouldn't feel
like organized chaos.
problem.body: We're juggling too many apps, link sharing services, messaging threads, and expired folder links. It's a hassle for everyone involved.
problem.pain_org: Organizers: Juggling separate ticket pages, group messages, and spreadsheets.
problem.pain_cre: Creatives: Chasing organizers, paying for expiring folder links, losing exposure.
problem.pain_att: Attendees: Lost ticket emails, missing event info, and hunting for photos afterwards.

organizer.label: For Organizers
organizer.headline:
Your event,
without the chaos.
organizer.body: You've got enough on your plate. Revelti handles the moving parts - tickets, crowd comms, media team, and real-time stats - so you can focus on making the night unforgettable.
organizer.feat1_desc: Set up your event, manage ticket tiers, and track sales live. No spreadsheets. It just works.
organizer.feat2_desc: Keep your crowd in the loop before, during, and after the event - all from one dashboard.
organizer.feat3_desc: Connect directly with your photographers. Their work goes straight into the official event gallery. Done.
organizer.feat4_desc: Beautiful, easy-to-read stats on everything from ticket sales to post-event engagement. Know your numbers.

creative.label: For Creatives
creative.headline:
Overhaul your workspace.
Own the event spotlight.
creative.body: You're not just taking photos — you're capturing memories. Revelti replaces expired links and messy handoffs with a visual ecosystem that stores your shots, delivers them instantly, and puts your brand in front of every attendee.
creative.feat1_desc: Your workspace and your gallery in one place. Upload your media files, export polished albums — all in one platform.
creative.feat2_desc: Deliver media directly to the official event. No expiring links, no lost folders, no messy DMs.
creative.feat3_desc: Every attendee looking for their photos sees your profile and your art. Thousands of organic eyes.
creative.feat4_title: A portfolio that does you justice
creative.feat4_desc: A stunning public profile to send to every future client — built automatically from the events you shoot.

attendee.label: For Attendees
attendee.headline: Buy tickets, get updates, and find your photos. All in one app.
attendee.body: Stop hunting through your email for lost tickets or searching social media for event photos. Revelti lets you securely buy your ticket and handles everything else automatically.
attendee.feat1_title: Buy your ticket and check in
attendee.feat1_desc: Find your favorite dance events, purchase tickets securely, and instantly get your entry QR code inside the app. No lost confirmation emails.
attendee.feat2_desc: Access up-to-date timetables, FAQ, and live announcements from the organizers so you never miss a workshop or a party.
attendee.feat3_desc: Connect with your dance community and see exactly who else is going before you even buy your pass.
attendee.feat4_desc: No more hunting down expired links and social media. The moment the party gallery is uploaded, they go straight to your app profile.

ecosystem.label: Better together
ecosystem.headline:
When everyone's
on the same stage,
the magic happens.
ecosystem.body: Revelti is a triangle, not a line. Organizers, creatives, and attendees all share the same platform - connected, in sync, and always in the loop.
ecosystem.org_body: Sets up events, sells tickets, broadcasts to the crowd, and manages their media team - all without leaving the platform.
ecosystem.cre_body: Stores and delivers media directly to the event. Their work is seen by every single attendee - automatically.
ecosystem.att_body: Buys their ticket, gets the updates, finds their photos - and relives the night, long after it's over.

waitlist.headline:
Be the first to
experience Revelti.
